name: Entry Points & CLI
description: Command-line interfaces and automation scripts that trigger scans and coordinate the scanning workflow. Primary entry point through src/index.js, plus specialized CLI utilities for batch scanning, dependency analysis, and integration with deployment systems.

name: Orchestration & Decision Engine
description: Core logic that coordinates security scanners and produces threat verdicts. The GuardDog class orchestrates all scanner modules in sequence, while the DecisionTree synthesizes all threat signals (VirusTotal votes, reputation scores, CVE findings, pattern matches, threat intelligence) into risk classifications: BARK (danger, >=100), WHINE (suspicious, 50-99), or SILENT (safe, <50). Provides both src/core/ structured versions and flat src/ module copies for compatibility.

name: Security Scanners
description: Threat detection modules that analyze packages for security vulnerabilities and suspicious behavior. Includes VirusTotal antivirus API integration, CVE/OSV vulnerability database queries, package reputation aggregation across npm/PyPI/GitHub/RubyGems, static code pattern analysis for malware detection, and multi-source threat intelligence collection. Contains both src/scanners/ structured versions and src/ flat module copies.

name: Alerts & Notification System
description: Notification delivery and external system integration. Sends Telegram bot alerts for dangerous packages (BARK verdicts), formats rich alert messages with threat details, and manages bot API communication. Includes both src/alerts/ structured version and src/ flat module copy.

name: Infrastructure & Operations
description: System-level operations, health monitoring, setup automation, and background task management. Includes SSH tunnel health checks with recovery (dittofeed, job-queue, postiz tunnels), threat intelligence daily refresh from public feeds, vulnerability database sync, git hook installation/removal, npm postinstall triggers, log consolidation, and interactive setup wizards. Low-level support for data directories, path resolution, and ESM module loading.

name: Configuration & Policy
description: Configuration files and policy definitions. Includes API endpoint URLs and timeouts (VirusTotal, npm, PyPI, GitHub, RubyGems), decision thresholds for verdict classification, trusted provider allowlist for fast-pass scanning, npm package manifest with CLI binaries and scripts, environment secrets template, and batch scan example payloads.

name: Documentation & Reference
description: User guides, operations manuals, and project documentation. Includes public README with installation and usage, project context and tech stack, operations manual with logging and retention policies, security disclosure policy, Claude Code agent configuration with verdict levels, skill command definition, and index for navigation.

name: Tests & Quality Assurance
description: Unit and integration test suite covering all major scanner modules, decision logic, alert formatting, scan history persistence, and batch analysis workflows.
